protocol.hypothesis: A band-extreme rejection at delay 0, or a reversal confirmation at every integer delay from 1 to 20 completed bars without a new extreme, may identify causal ZigZag bends across intraday and daily intervals. Leg ratio and wick are factorial filters.

research_provenance.source: User chart and requested 1D/4H/subday bend entries 2026-11-08
research_provenance.note: Original imported Trendoscope sticky/adaptive bands cannot be exactly reproduced; use explicit BB20 population standard deviation. No visual retrospective pivot is treated as a tradable past signal.

protocol.parameter_rationale: Full integer delay scope 1–20 (approximately one trading month on 1D; increasingly shorter wall-clock periods below 1D), plus same-bar delay 0. Cross with both confirmation types, 0/100% prior-leg threshold and 0/50% pivot-wick threshold. All 164 combinations are declared before the full run; no sparse sampling of candle delays.
protocol.baseline: 25%-capital buy-and-hold on the same instrument/timeframe/costs; bend__close__d1__r0__w0 is the first-next-bar confirmation control.
protocol.signal_rule: On each completed bar compute BB20 SMA(close) +/- 2 population standard deviations. A one-sided band touch creates/replaces latest provisional high/low. At delay 0, the touching candle closes back inside its band with body away from the extreme. At each exact delay 1–20 since the last new extreme, close requires an opposite-direction body and close versus previous bar; break requires close beyond previous bar low/high. Optional filters: current leg >= preceding leg, pivot wick >=50% of pivot candle range. One signal per pivot. Long after low, short after high; fill at next bar open. Opposite qualifying entry reverses. No future pivot confirmation.
protocol.signal_semantics: Causal bend entry at completed candle close; future 3/10-bar returns and correlations are diagnostic outcomes only, never signal inputs.
protocol.evaluation_unit: Independent 1m RUB virtual account per symbol; this is not a combined portfolio.
protocol.execution_timing: Observe completed signal candle; fill next available candle open. No intrabar order or historical pivot-center fill.
protocol.holding_period: Until opposite qualifying signal; no fixed target in this entry-only comparison.
protocol.rebalance_rule: No intrabar rebalance; at most one position per account.
required_data: 1-minute OHLCV for 15M and 30M; absent in frozen snapshot
protocol.availability_lag: At the signal candle close; 4H uses only finished groups and subhourly bars require actual minute candles.
protocol.cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
protocol.selection: Compare all 164 preregistered variants across every eligible symbol and available timeframe. Analyze per-month and annual net returns and exploratory feature correlations, but do not promote due unavailable 15M/30M source, unverified original band parity and previously viewed late sample.
limitations: 15M/30M require real minute candles and are SOURCE_MISSING in the frozen snapshot
Band formula is an explicit adaptation, not the original imported library
Feature correlations use future outcomes only for offline diagnostics and are not causal proof
Short borrow, dividends and splits are not fully modeled

validation.note: DATA_READY confirms data and report gates only; it does not approve a trading strategy.
